Description: WorkNet presentation server in us-east-2. Creating this stack consumes AWS credits. No secrets in parameters or UserData.

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.arch: One presentation VM hosts the public HTTPS proxy and private API, database and cache.
must: Keep the approved FREE plan and single-server budget; no provider secrets in the template.

ref.has: Budget, runtime, backup, administrative access and retirement procedure.

KeyPairName.Description: Existing Lightsail SSH public key in us-east-2

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Consolidated presentation runtime avoids extra managed-service costs. Alternate SSH supports an operator network that cannot reach the standard port.
must: SSH stays limited to the operator /32; only the standard SSH port additionally permits the AWS browser client.
Do not replace the instance or discard its persistent volumes during an application update.

Properties.UserData:
#!/bin/bash
set -eu
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update
apt-get install -y docker.io docker-compose-v2 ca-certificates
systemctl enable --now docker
install -d -m 0755 /opt/worknet/releases /opt/worknet/web
install -d -m 0700 /etc/worknet /var/backups/worknet

com.aws.cloudformation.Context.why: Stable public address keeps the presentation hostname and certificates valid across ordinary restarts.
must: Keep the address attached while the service is active; stopping the VM does not retire retained resources.
